home.welcomeBody: Your space for writing and worldbuilding. Want a one-minute tour of the home screen?
home.createBody: Start a new project from a template, or import an existing Inkweld archive.
home.projectsEmptyBody: Projects you create or join will appear here as cards.
home.projectsGridBody: Click a project card to open it in the editor.
home.syncBody: Sync all of your activated projects with the server in one click.
home.userMenuBody: Switch themes, servers, and profiles, and open your settings here. You can replay this tour from this menu at any time.

project.welcomeBody: This is where you write and build your world. Want a quick orientation?
project.treeBody: Documents, folders, and worldbuilding elements live here. Drag items to reorganize them, or right-click for more actions.
project.searchBody: Search across every document and element in the project (Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + F).
project.tabsBody: Everything you open appears as a tab, so you can move between documents and elements quickly.
project.mediaBody: Store and organize images for your project — covers, portraits, maps, and more.
project.publishBody: Export your work as EPUB, PDF, Markdown, or HTML when you're ready to share it.
project.settingsBody: Rename your project and adjust project-level options here.
project.shortcutsBody: Press Ctrl/Cmd + P to quickly open any file, and Ctrl/Cmd + F to find text in the current document. You can replay this tour from the account menu at any time.
